title: Prove inspection and local persistence
value: Establish which account and runtime were actually read, what was missed, and whether evidence survives restart.
deliverable: Accept the shipped read-only collectors against one real AWS account and one local runtime; test the storage and restore path.
exit: Account mismatch blocks collection; denied and truncated reads remain visible; a snapshot survives service restart; a SQLite backup restores the same record hashes.
depends: Administrator-provided identity, namespace/socket access and persistent storage.

title: Turn catalogue entries into scoped test definitions
value: Prevent a plausible scenario description from being treated as an executable or applicable test.
deliverable: A scenario editor and applicability engine with six AWS deployment profiles, exact targets, dependency proof, concrete limits and evidence queries.
exit: Unresolved limits, incompatible actions, empty target sets and stale snapshots block planning. The 36 research scenarios remain drafts until specified.

title: Collect incident evidence under a known workload
value: Measure customer impact and recovery instead of inferring them from resource state.
deliverable: Bounded k6/Locust traffic, CloudWatch/Prometheus collectors, UTC incident events, transaction reconciliation and local raw-evidence retention.
exit: Baseline, impairment and recovery windows are reproducible; denominators and missing samples are explicit; evidence links to one run and exact target scope.
depends: Specified scenarios and approved observation endpoints.

title: Execute one supervised non-production fault
value: Close the loop from approved plan to observed incident without creating an uncontrolled executor.
deliverable: A separate write-capable FIS worker with durable run state, idempotency, target-hash approval, independent stop monitoring and cleanup verification.
exit: A single approved low-blast-radius test completes; retries do not duplicate the fault; losing this console does not remove the stop path; incomplete cleanup blocks closure.
depends: Evidence collectors, least-privilege execution role and tested recovery procedure.

title: Validate responder actions and business recovery
value: Distinguish infrastructure restoration from a resolved operational incident.
deliverable: Alert-delivery and acknowledgement events, runbook evidence, escalation timestamps, business-transaction checks and repeat-test comparison.
exit: Detection, acknowledgement, mitigation, stable recovery and data correctness each have attributable evidence or an explicit inconclusive result.
depends: An approved incident drill and access to the incident system.

title: Run repeatable campaigns and compare regressions
value: Show whether releases improve or weaken the same tested behavior.
deliverable: Persisted campaign schedules, workload/version pinning, trend views and release gates based on matched scenarios and complete evidence.
exit: A campaign resumes after restart without duplicate execution; comparisons reject mismatched scope or scenario revisions; missing evidence cannot satisfy a release gate.
depends: Reliable single-run execution and reproducible evidence.

title: Qualify production and multi-account use
value: Expand only after identity, failure containment and operational controls have been demonstrated.
deliverable: Separate inspection/execution identities, multi-user approvals, signed evidence, retention policy, restore drills and account/Region-specific safety controls.
exit: A security review and production game-day acceptance approve each account, Region and fault class; no approval is inherited merely from a non-production pass.
depends: Non-production acceptance and organization change approval.
